description: A planar orbital cargo dispatch desk. Schedule up to six signed tangential/radial burn orders, compare the flight against an unpowered lane, scrub or play the mission, and meet a moving depot with both distance and relative-speed criteria. Three raising/lowering routes include exact Hohmann reference plans and editable target phase.

numericalAssumptions: Earth-centred inertial 2D Newtonian point-mass field; mu 398600.4418 km^3/s^2 and Earth radius 6371 km.
Fourth-order Runge–Kutta at maximum 10-second steps, split at exact impulse times.
Impulses use local counterclockwise tangential and outward radial bases, in m/s.
Depot is an analytically propagated circular orbit.
Rendezvous qualification: sampled separation under 50 km AND relative speed under 50 m/s.
Initial mission phase supports analytic Hohmann rendezvous; users may change phase.
limitations: No atmosphere, oblateness, third bodies, finite-duration thrust, fuel mass, or docking/contact dynamics.
Closest approach and arrival use samples no more than 10 seconds apart; very brief close passes may be missed.
Earth contact is detected after a propagation step and its time is approximate.
Preview horizon is finite; arbitrary high-energy trajectories can escape the view before zoom adjustment.
Tangential direction is counterclockwise rather than velocity-aligned for eccentric or retrograde motion.
No persistence; reload resets the session.
repairs: Removed an unused unpowered-orbit numerical propagation; its circular reference is drawn analytically. No numerical failures required repairs.
